lesson: A single global variable-order heuristic is not a valid cross-algebra wormhole, and lexical/name-sensitive tie-breaking can create false transfer evidence.
supersession: The evidence-closure lab replaces global heuristic transfer with regime-conditioned crystals, input-order cold baselines, anonymized names, sealed holdouts, and discovery-cost accounting.
law: Negative evidence is retained and may not be erased by later positive results.
